meta.title: Wohlauf · Centre for physiotherapy in Hannover-Südstadt
meta.description: Centre for physiotherapy in Hannover's Südstadt. Six therapists, statutory and private insurance, or without a prescription. Choose on the figure where it hurts.

hero.p: Choose a body region. You see what is typical, how we treat it and how to get an appointment.
hero.empty: Choose a region on the left or tap the figure.

zones.name: Head and jaw
typ: Clicking or pain in front of the ear
Clenching or grinding at night
Headache that starts in the neck
zones.wir: Examine jaw, neck and posture together, relax the muscles, teach home exercises.
zones.rez: Physiotherapy (KG) or manual therapy (MT), often prescribed by a dentist

zones.name: Neck
typ: Stiff neck in the morning
Pain when looking over the shoulder
Pain radiating into the arm or back of the head
zones.wir: Measure range of motion side to side, mobilise joints, strengthen the deep neck muscles, review your desk setup.

zones.name: Shoulder
typ: Pain when dressing and reaching overhead
Unable to lie on that side at night
Loss of strength when lifting
zones.wir: Include the shoulder blade and upper back, widen the range step by step, strengthen the rotator cuff.
zones.rez: KG, MT, after surgery also equipment-based physiotherapy (KGG)

zones.name: Back
zones.s: Lumbago, slipped disc, chronic back pain
typ: Pain after long sitting or standing
Stiff in the morning, better during the day
Pain radiating into the buttock or leg
zones.wir: Examine spine and hips, test the nerves, mobilise joints, strengthen the trunk specifically.

zones.name: Elbow and hand
zones.s: Tennis elbow, tendon irritation, after fractures
typ: Pain when gripping and turning
Tingling in the fingers
Stiff wrist after a cast
zones.wir: Load the tendons at the right dose, mobilise wrist and fingers, nerve gliding, aids for work and sport.

zones.name: Hip
typ: Pain on the first steps after sitting
Pain in the groin
Limping after longer walks
zones.wir: Measure mobility and strength, retrain walking, after surgery build up by the hospital's protocol.
zones.rez: KG, KGG, manual lymph drainage (MLD) after surgery

zones.name: Knee
zones.s: Meniscus, cruciate ligament, osteoarthritis, front-of-knee pain
typ: Pain going downstairs and squatting
Swelling after load
The knee feels unstable or gives way
zones.wir: Check leg alignment and strength, document bending and straightening in degrees, raise the load in stages.

zones.name: Foot and ankle
typ: Pain on the first steps in the morning
Instability after a sprain
Heel pain when running
zones.wir: Stabilise the ankle, strengthen calf and foot, plan the load for daily life and sport.

leistungen.title: Your prescription, translated
leistungen.p: German prescriptions use abbreviations. Tap one to read what it means.

slip.title: Prescription for therapy
slip.startNote: No later than 28 days after it was issued. If it says “dringlicher Behandlungsbedarf” (urgent), it is 14 days.

rezept.p: Active and passive techniques for mobility, strength and coordination. The most common prescription.
Specific hands-on techniques for joints, muscles and nerves after a detailed examination.
Strength training on equipment in small groups, with your own plan and supervision.
Gentle technique against swelling, for example after surgery or injury.
A dentist's prescription usually says KG or MT with the note CMD. We treat jaw, chewing muscles and neck together.

erg.p: Mud pack or hot air before treatment. Relaxes the muscles and prepares the tissue.
Cooling after surgery and with acute irritation, against swelling and pain.
Stimulation current against pain and to activate weakened muscles.

ohne.p: Straight to us, without a doctor's prescription. You pay yourself.
Running style, strength and jump tests, a plan for returning to sport.
Extra sessions alongside your prescription, with a report for your check-up.

termin.title: What happens at your first visit
termin.p: Four steps. Afterwards you know what is going on and what comes next.

stages.p: Since when, doing what, what helps and what doesn't. And what you want to be able to do again. The goal sets the route.
li: Prescription, doctor's letters and scans
Daily life, work, sport
Your goal in one sentence

stages.p: The assessment: how do you move, what triggers the pain, what differs from one side to the other?
li: Posture and gait
Range of motion in degrees, left and right
Strength, stability, nerve tests

stages.p: We treat what the assessment shows: with manual techniques and with exercises you control yourself.
li: Manual therapy and soft-tissue work
Active exercises at the right dose
You tell us how it feels at any time

stages.p: Two or three exercises that fit your day. Sent to your phone as photos, so nothing gets lost at home.
li: Exercises with pictures and dosage
What to rest and what to load
The next visit and what we check then

termin.note: Times for a 60-minute first visit. With a prescription the length follows the prescription; the order stays the same.

praxis.title: Your team
praxis.p: The same person treats you from start to finish. During holidays or illness a colleague who knows your file takes over.

team.q: Manual therapy, sports physiotherapy, sectoral Heilpraktiker licence for physiotherapy
Equipment-based physiotherapy, rehab after knee and hip surgery
Manual lymph drainage, shoulder, aftercare following fractures
Running analysis, ankle and Achilles tendon

room: Eight treatment rooms, a training floor with equipment
Tram stop Geibelstraße, 3 minutes on foot

items.a: No. With a prescription we bill your statutory or private insurer. Without one you come to us directly as a self-pay patient: our head of practice, Ronja Dreesen, holds the sectoral Heilpraktiker licence for physiotherapy and may examine and treat without a doctor's prescription.

items.q: What do I bring to the first visit?
items.a: Your prescription, your insurance card, any doctor's letters or scans, and comfortable clothes. We have a towel for you.

items.q: How soon can I get an appointment?
items.a: That depends on the week. The next free first visit is shown at the top of the page. After surgery or with acute complaints please call, and we will try to make something possible.
With a prescription the length follows the prescription. For self-pay patients we offer 30, 45 and 60 minutes; we recommend 60 minutes for the first visit so there is time for the assessment.

items.q: I need to cancel. What now?
items.a: Please cancel at least 24 hours ahead, by phone or e-mail. We charge for appointments missed at short notice because we can no longer give the time to someone else.

night.title: In pain and can't sleep?
night.lead: The centre is closed right now. Two things you can try straight away.

tips.p: A thick pillow under your knees. This takes load off the lower back.
A pillow between your knees, top leg slightly bent. With shoulder pain, lie on the other side.

night.contact: Write to us now and we will call you back as soon as we are in.
night.warn: With numbness, paralysis, fever or after a fall, do not wait: medical on-call service 116 117, emergencies 112.
